events.author: Solver
events.name: A Grand Speech

options.text: Our enemies will never corrupt our precious bodily fluids!
It pains me to announce that [character] is made out of glass and will have to retire as governor for his own safety.
Each citizen of [city] who is taller than my horse gets a fistful of gold.

events.text: The people of [city] have gathered to hear you deliver a grand speech. Your oration skills are known far and wide, and this is to be one of your best speeches. As [character] stands beside you, he looks uncomfortable in his ornate governor's robe. Surely [character] could not be worried about you inspiring the masses filling the streets below? What message will you deliver to the eager crowd?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: A Matter of Incest

options.text: Throw them in jail as the law commands.
Kill them! Kill them all!
Why don't we join them?
Jail [character] for fabricating these rumors.

events.text: Your spymaster, [character], informs you that [character] and [character] are lovers. Their indecent affections for each other are the talk of the court and leave a hollow feeling in your soul. How shall these incestuous matters be handled?

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: A Poor Investment

options.text: He may lack honor, but I do not.
I cannot afford that!

events.text: Recently you lent money to an ambitious merchant who promised to return it tenfold by. Unfortunately, today you have received word that his business venture has utterly failed due to. The merchant has fled the city in shame. Your money has been lost. And worse yet, his other creditors say he told them you would cover his debts.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: A Sound Investment

options.text: I invest in people!

events.text: A short time ago an ambitious, yet cash-strapped, merchant approached you for a small loan to start her business. Today she has sent word that her business has succeeded beyond her wildest dreams and she is able to repay you with a significant bonus on top.

events.author: Zorbaz

tip: As leader: +5% State Religion Spread Chance

events.name: Altruism

options.text: Yes, we must save everyone.
Are you mad? We can't save them all.

events.text: A chill from the throne seeps into your bones as you sit in contemplation. Your courtiers are always scheming and plotting how they might earn your favor, but they never pause to consider the lowliest of the land - the farmers, miners, and soldiers who die, one way or another, for your glory. The court's trickery and falsities have finally driven you to the brink. You resolve that more must be done for the weakest, no matter the cost.

events.author: Solver
events.name: An Unusual Chancellor

options.text: Nonsense rumblings. My trusty horse [character] will make a great Chancellor.
Have all the nobles in the room killed.
I am the ruler, and I am the Chancellor, and I am the aristocracy. I am all of [rival].

events.text: During an ordinary meeting with the aristocracy, one of the nobles lets it slip that many in the upper class have grown worried about the senior political leadership. The position of Chancellor is said to be of particular concern, with some questioning whether there is anyone in all of [rival] you would be prepared to fully trust as Chancellor.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Asceticism

options.text: It is good to be the [title].
No. I'm not allowed to go crazy. Stop it.

events.text: Lying in a sunny field one day, you have an irresistible urge to forgo all meat and alcohol. All the pomp and circumstance of the court has finally driven you to your wits' end. You decide you shall not eat any more fine foods. You shall only drink water and eat of the field - wheat, barley, sorghum and vegetables with salt, abstaining from all pleasure. Also, baths and clean clothes are overrated. Maybe you will sleep outside as well from now on? If the court wants to meet with you, then they can meet you where you are.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Bee of Bumble

options.text: Eat the bee of bumble.
Leave the bee alone.
Head-butt the bee. Show it the power of a [title]!

events.text: While you are enjoying a slice of honeyed bread, a very large bee, striped black and yellow, lands upon your meal. In a flash of inspiration, you know what to do!

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Bountiful Harvest

options.text: Behold the fruits of prosperity.

events.text: Perfect weather and a long growing season have combined to produce an extremely rich harvest this year!

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Carnivorism

options.text: This is the life! Bow before me, mortals!
Just think about how all that meat comes out during latrine visits.

events.text: Standing beside a river one day, you have an irresistible urge to forgo all fruits and vegetables. All the fawning and back-patting of the court has finally driven you nutty. You decide you shall not eat anything green. You shall only drink wine and eat only meat - pork, chevon, venison and beef with salt for taste. Also, manners and clean clothes are overrated. Maybe you will sleep outside and wear furs like your honorable ancestors did. The court must bow to my desires.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Code Clarifications

options.text: Simplify, simplify.

events.text: A chance remark got you started on the path of law reformation, and it looks like your work has paid off! By clarifying several arcane regulations, streamlining an approval process or two, and eliminating an important edge case you have greatly increased the efficiency of your bureaucracy.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Crop Failure

options.text: Hand out the grain!
I cannot help.

events.text: A series of blights, a plague of locusts, and a streak of dry weather have come together to form the worst harvest in living memory. Only by providing food from the empire’s granaries can you prevent widespread starvation!

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Dungeons of Insanity

options.text: Keep them in the dungeons, shall we.
They shall die by my hand.
Pleasure them with forbidden delights.
Shower them in gold, reminding them who is the leader.

events.text: Your courtly escapades of the lubricious variety just haven't been enough. In a moment of brilliance, you have [character] and [character] abducted and chained in the dungeons for your pleasure. Thrilling as the spectacle of their bodies hanging from the dungeon wall is, what shall be done?

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Earthquake!

options.text: Provide stone to help with the repairs.
I cannot help.

events.text: You awaken to a terrible rumbling sound and the entire building shaking around you. Several of your favorite vases fall from their pedestals, and a large crack appears in the ceiling, but then the shaking stops as suddenly as it started. While your palace seems largely intact, much of [city] is less sturdily built.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Gift of Land

options.text: [rival] needs to extend its reach.
Sell the parcel to the highest bidders.
Survey the land to determine its true potential.

events.text: [character] has recently come into a vast expanse of family land. He originally planned to add to his estates, but now he wishes to make a gift of this land to the court. Shall we sell the property for a vast windfall, or shall we expand our borders?

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Grief

options.text: And upon the body, as well.

events.text: Mourning has weighed upon the soul.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Hedonism

options.text: Everybody just have a good time!
Stop and consider this - hangovers.

events.text: Reclining upon a sofa, the soft patter of rain soothes your mind while you contemplate your empire. All the austerity and formality of the court has finally broken your heart. In a fit of rage, you decide that you will host the most luxurious parties and invite the most alluring foreigners and consorts from around the world. You will not be bound by petty religious piety or the rule-bound ministers of the court. It's party time!

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Insane Love

options.text: Sneak into his bedchamber and profess my love.
Threaten his family, forcing [character] to marry me.
Head back to the palace for a drink, alone.

events.text: [character] has caught your attention, intoxicating you, driving you mad. You must have him. Late one night you arrive outside his family villa. You don't know why you are here. How shall you woo [character]?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Left Behind

options.text: Sell it and give the proceeds to the poor.
Commission an inspiring public obelisk.
Use it to decorate the royal estates.

events.text: Scouts have discovered the remains of a merchant caravan sacked by raiders. Among the bodies and discarded supplies lie great slabs of exotic green marble, too large for simple thieves to carry. The court merchant [character] is ecstatic about the find, suggesting several uses for the valuable stone.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Madness, Blood, and Love

options.text: What a thrill!
What have I done! There is no hope for me.
Surely the gods will help.

events.text: The sleeping forms of your lover [character] and your wife [character] lay in a tangle upon your bed. Blood paints a grisly picture upon the walls. You remember their cries of pleasure and terror, a sharp contrast to the motionless bodies that lie before you. The sword in your hand drips red. What a pretty color!

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Plotting Nobles

options.text: Grab the sword and kill [character].
Guards, seize [character] and [character]. Throw them in jail!
Carry on a polite conversation, then slip away.

events.text: Overhearing [character] and [character], you are certain that they are plotting to kill you. As you leave the court, you are stopped by [character], hand resting on the sword at his side. He will surely kill you unless you act. They know you know, which means you cannot be left alive. If you kill him now, then you will have one less enemy.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Poor Quality Iron

options.text: The soldiers will need to train harder to compensate.
Commission new weapons.
I cannot help.

events.text: A series of training mishaps have revealed that the weapons of many of our soldiers are made from poor quality iron and are prone to breaking if they hit an opponent's armor. How will you resolve this?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Pushed Too Far

outcomes.label: Trait Pushed Too Far Option 0 Bitter
Trait Pushed Too Far Option 0 Cruel
Trait Pushed Too Far Option 0 Intolerant

options.text: We cannot tolerate such nefarious actions.

events.text: In a shocking development, [character] is brought before you in shackles by a squad of soldiers. The officer in charge accuses him of conspiring to sabotage the military training grounds in [city]. Troops discovered him near the water supply with a flask of poison. [character] confesses that it was your animosity towards others on the court that sent him on the path to ruin.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Royal Tragedies

options.text: We must pursue practical solutions.

tip: As leader: +5% State Religion Spread Chance

options.text: Truly, we are cursed. Prayer for us.

events.text: It has been a trying time in the royal household. Your son [character] was struck by a falling stone and killed instantly. At the palace, your husband, [character], has fallen ill with a mysterious ailment, and healers make no promises of recovery. Where will you turn for aid in this tragic moment?

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Surplus Stone

options.text: I’ll put it to good use!

events.text: A happy merchant awaits you in court. It seems that she had been traveling through [city] with a load of Stone when she discovered an amazing deal on cheese via a local merchant. To free up wagon space she wishes to donate the stone to you, “for the glory of [rival]!”

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Test of Faith

options.text: We shall honor the God of this ancient scroll.
Crack down on all cults and heathen beliefs.

events.text: During the renovation of a temple, workers uncover the remnants of an ancient scroll. Our holy men interpret the scroll, and find therein the tenets of a great deity. This lost "Book of Law" describes a utopian society. Our ministers advise against rash action, but you worry this is a test of faith. Will you spread the word of this new faith, or keep its codes to yourself?

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: The Great Fire of [city]

options.text: Provide wood to rebuild with!
Perhaps stone is a better choice.
I cannot help.

events.text: A devastating fire has ravaged [city], destroying the homes of many of your poorest citizens. As your people struggle to rebuild, they look to you for aid.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: The Letter of the Law

options.text: I must close this loophole!
I cannot help.

events.text: In a recent attempt to become known as a great lawmaker you passed a law relating to. Unfortunately, an advisor has just informed you that are taking advantage of a loophole in this law in order to.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Up in Smoke

options.text: Rebuild the library in its original state.
Enlist scribes to replace the lost scrolls.
Give the sage permission to rebuild however he desires.

events.text: A fire in [city] has reduced its most ancient library to ruins. Knowing that you have a reputation as a Scholar Archetype, a local sage has come to request funds for the library's reconstruction. How shall we respond to their request?
